verdict.rationale: Grok Build is itself an official xAI CLI. It has a first-party install script, a documented CLI reference with subcommands (`grok import`, `grok export`, `grok inspect`, `grok mcp add`), and a headless mode with `plain`, `json`, or `streaming-json` output for scripts and bots. Community users independently confirm headless `-p` mode and running the binary. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of the full CLI workflow past login (one tester was blocked by subscription gating).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: curl -fsSL https://x.ai/cli/install.sh | bash   # macOS / Linux / Git Bash
Use headless mode for scripts, bots, or other machine-friendly tasks.
`grok export <session-id> [output]` | Export a session transcript as Markdown
